patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Asana and Office Timeline share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Asana only if your buying job matches “Cross-functional work management with goals, workflows and AI Studio — Starter from $10.99” rather than Office Timeline's shape. Choose Office Timeline only if your buying job matches “PowerPoint-native timeline / Gantt specialist (now Lucen Timeline) — Free add-in; Lite fro” rather than Asana's shape. Workflow advantage: Asana leans work-management, team-collaboration-work; Office Timeline leans timeline-reporting. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Asana and Office Timeline share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Asana is Cross-functional work management with goals, workflows and AI Studio — Starter from $10.99/user/mo annual.; Office Timeline is PowerPoint-native timeline / Gantt specialist (now Lucen Timeline) — Free add-in; Lite from $9/user/mo annual..
- Workflow coverage skew: Asana-leaning work-management, team-collaboration-work, resource-planning vs Office Timeline-leaning timeline-reporting.
- Researched limits: Asana — Advanced features and deeper automation often require Advanced+; Office Timeline — Not a work OS — no monday/Hive-class boards, automations or workload management.

Limitations — Asana: Advanced features and deeper automation often require Advanced+; AI Studio credit packaging can raise TCO beyond Starter seat floors; Office Timeline: Not a work OS — no monday/Hive-class boards, automations or workload management; Centre of gravity is PowerPoint presentation timelines, not live team task execution.

Poor-fit cases: Asana is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Advanced features and deeper automation often require Advanced+ · Office Timeline is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a work OS — no monday/Hive-class boards, automations or workload management · Avoid Asana if you actually need Office Timeline's motion (PowerPoint-native timeline / Gantt specialist (now Lucen Timeline) — Free add-in)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
